verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents a first-party log streaming service that exports tenant logs in near real-time to a log analysis service, with configurable content type and format and a payload preview in the Dashboard. This covers the stream/export-to-SIEM part of the story. The evidence does not say these logs are tamper-evident or name the event categories they cover. Missing for 10: any tamper-evidence or integrity guarantee, explicit coverage of authentication and admin activity events, named SIEM destinations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can capture tamper-evident audit logs of authentication and admin activity and stream or export them to my SIEM

citations.quote: Auth0's log streaming service allows you to export tenant logs to a log analysis service. You can choose the content type and form and preview the payload using the Auth0 Dashboard.
Describes how to export your logs in near real-time using log streaming.
